verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only adjacent building blocks. Connect lets platforms review and take action on connected accounts in the Dashboard, view disputes across connected accounts, and manage payout schedules and external accounts. It also uses identity verification to reduce platform risk and emits Connect webhook events. Nothing in the pack documents a risk-monitoring layer, so this is a thin partial. Missing for 10: per-sub-merchant fraud and credit-risk signals, alerts on anomalous sellers, an explicit pause-payouts control, a documented offboarding/rejection workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
